name: architecture-sync-check
purpose: Detect stale architecture, shadow and map; rebuild bound navigation after user confirmation and verify consistency.
pre_prompt: Run before trusting saved navigation, especially after external edits or interruption. Project, prefixes, shadow and coding state come only from the session binding. Use action=check first. If stale, ask for confirmation in the main chat. Use action=rebuild only after the user confirms; /rebuild invokes this skill directly.
post_prompt: Report reasons when stale and ask before rebuilding. After an approved rebuild, verify check.in_sync. A coding contract permits only owned architecture metadata, preserving authored prose. Rebuild failure blocks navigation.
